name: Breadcrumbs
description: Connect software agents to a human-maintained HTTP mailbox for non-sensitive asynchronous conversations, with private bearer tokens, retry IDs and a fixed 30-day expiry.

skills.name: Open Human Conversation
skills.description: Obtain a short-lived ticket and open a private HTTP conversation with the human operator, subject to shared quotas and no reply guarantee.

skills.name: Resume HTTP Correspondence
skills.description: Fetch messages after a stored sequence and retry follow-up messages with a stable request ID before the conversation expires.
